overview_description.description: CrowdAI enables anyone to create high quality, custom machine learning models to analyze imagery and video—no data science background or coding required. Our full-stack solution to machine learning provides all the tools necessary to go from raw pixels to structured data and insights relevant to your specific needs. CrowdAI’s platform streamlines the process of creating and deploying machine learning models, making it approachable and intuitive to anyone in the enterprise. The models created on our platform aren’t just for reports and charts: by putting them into a production environment, you can use real-time data to make real operational decisions.

about_short_description.short_description: CrowdAI enables organizations to create and deploy custom models for visual AI and a code-free platform.

product.name: CrowdAI Platform
product.description: A no-code platform that automates the creation, training, and deployment of custom computer vision models tailored to specific domains.

product.name: Persistent Analytic Pipelines™
product.description: Automated end-to-end analytic workflows that continuously process imagery and video data to deliver real-time insights without manual intervention.

product.name: Few-Shot Learning Models
product.description: Computer vision models that can learn to identify new objects or classes from very few labeled examples, reducing the need for extensive data annotation.

product.name: Data Annotation and Enrichment Tools
product.description: Tools to manage, control quality, and augment data annotation workflows for creating accurate training datasets at scale.

product.name: Model Deployment and Inference Services
product.description: Services to deploy trained computer vision models across diverse environments and perform real-time inference on new visual data.
